theme.en: AI Demand Pushes Capacity Into New Constraints
theme.zh: AI需求将产能推向新的约束

dek.en: Leading-edge logic, memory research, and custom accelerators keep advancing, but export rules, power-grid reviews, and materials requirements increasingly determine where that capacity can land. The bottleneck is spreading from the chip itself to the infrastructure and policy around it.
dek.zh: 先进逻辑制程、存储研发与定制加速器继续推进，但出口管制、电网审查和材料要求正日益决定这些产能能在何处落地。瓶颈正在从芯片本身扩散到其周边的基础设施与政策环境。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Waymo Designs a 5nm Robocar Accelerator Above 1,000 TOPS
title.zh: Waymo设计5nm自动驾驶加速器，算力超过1,000 TOPS

summary.en: Waymo has designed a 5nm machine-learning accelerator for its autonomous-driving stack with more than 1,000 TOPS and an emphasis on very low latency. Bringing the chip in-house gives Waymo tighter control over the timing, power, and sensor-processing requirements that general-purpose accelerators do not optimize for, while adding another large systems company to the custom-silicon trend.
summary.zh: Waymo为其自动驾驶系统设计了一款5nm机器学习加速器，算力超过1,000 TOPS，并重点压低延迟。自研芯片让Waymo能更紧密地控制通用加速器难以同时优化的时序、功耗和传感器处理需求，也使采用定制硅方案的大型系统公司再添一员。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC's 1.6nm Production Could Start in Late 2026
title.zh: 台积电1.6nm或于2026年底量产

summary.en: TSMC could begin mass production of 1.6nm-class chips as early as the fourth quarter of 2026, according to a new report. If that schedule holds, it would accelerate the foundry's leading-edge ramp and give high-performance-computing customers an earlier path beyond its 2nm generation; the date remains a reported target rather than confirmed output.
summary.zh: 据最新报道，台积电最早可能在2026年第四季度开始量产1.6nm级芯片。若进度兑现，这将加快其先进制程爬坡，并让高性能计算客户更早获得2nm世代之后的工艺选择；目前这一时间点仍是报道中的目标，并非已确认的产出。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Micron Plans a $10 Billion Research Push as AI Lifts Memory Demand
title.zh: AI推升存储需求，Micron计划投入100亿美元研发

summary.en: Micron plans a $10 billion research push as AI systems increase demand for higher-bandwidth and higher-capacity memory. The scale of the commitment shows that the memory race is shifting from a cyclical capacity response toward longer-horizon process and product development, although the candidate report does not specify how quickly the spending will be deployed.
summary.zh: 随着AI系统提高对高带宽、大容量存储的需求，Micron计划投入100亿美元推进研发。如此规模的承诺表明，存储竞争正从周期性的扩产反应转向更长期的制程与产品开发，不过候选报道并未说明这笔资金将以多快速度投入。

title.en: CXMT Supplies 11.3% of 2026 DRAM Growth, but Its Share Is Forecast to Ease
title.zh: CXMT贡献2026年DRAM增量的11.3%，后续占比或回落

summary.en: CXMT is estimated to account for 11.3% of global DRAM production growth in 2026, while a Hanwha Securities forecast puts its contribution at 6.9% in 2027. The figures suggest China now has meaningful incremental DRAM capacity, but also that expansion alone may not translate into a rapid challenge to the three incumbent suppliers across products and customers.
summary.zh: 据估算，CXMT将贡献2026年全球DRAM产量增量的11.3%，而韩华证券预测其2027年的增量贡献占比将降至6.9%。这些数字说明中国已形成不可忽视的DRAM新增产能，但也表明单纯扩产未必能让其迅速在产品与客户层面挑战三大现有供应商。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: An $85 Billion TSMC Spending Forecast Lifts ASML
title.zh: 台积电850亿美元支出预测提振ASML

summary.en: ASML shares rose after a forecast put TSMC spending at $85 billion, reinforcing expectations for sustained leading-edge tool demand. The figure is a market forecast rather than reported TSMC guidance, but it highlights how rapidly an aggressive foundry buildout would flow into EUV and other equipment orders.
summary.zh: 一项预测将台积电支出估至850亿美元后，ASML股价上涨，市场对先进制程设备需求持续的预期随之增强。该数字属于市场预测，并非台积电已公布的业绩指引，但它凸显了激进的晶圆厂扩建将如何迅速转化为EUV及其他设备订单。

title.en: SandboxAQ Searches for PFAS-Free Semiconductor Materials
title.zh: SandboxAQ寻找无PFAS半导体材料替代方案

summary.en: SandboxAQ is working to identify PFAS-free alternatives for semiconductor manufacturing, where fluorinated chemicals are embedded in multiple process steps. Viable substitutes matter because tighter PFAS regulation could create qualification and supply risks for fabs; any replacement will still need to meet unusually strict purity, performance, and process-compatibility requirements.
summary.zh: SandboxAQ正尝试为半导体制造寻找无PFAS替代材料，而含氟化学品目前嵌入多道工艺环节。可行替代品之所以重要，是因为更严格的PFAS监管可能给晶圆厂带来认证与供应风险；任何替代方案仍须满足极严苛的纯度、性能和工艺兼容性要求。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Nvidia Denies a China-Specific AI Chip Launch by Year-End
title.zh: Nvidia否认将在年底前推出中国特供AI芯片

summary.en: Nvidia denied a report that it plans to roll out a China-specific AI chip by the end of 2026. The denial leaves its China roadmap unresolved as the company tries to serve a large inference market without crossing U.S. export-control thresholds or running into Beijing's push for domestic alternatives.
summary.zh: Nvidia否认了有关其计划在2026年底前推出中国特供AI芯片的报道。该回应意味着其中国市场路线图仍未明朗，公司既要争取庞大的推理市场，又不能越过美国出口管制门槛，还要面对北京推动国产替代的压力。

title.en: Texas Pauses 1,800 Data-Center Projects for a Grid Audit
title.zh: 得州暂停1,800个数据中心项目以进行电网审查

summary.en: Texas has reportedly paused roughly 1,800 data-center projects while ERCOT conducts a comprehensive audit of the development pipeline. The action turns electricity access into an immediate gating factor for AI infrastructure, with consequences for the timing of server, accelerator, memory, and networking demand even when chips themselves are available.
summary.zh: 据报道，得州已暂停约1,800个数据中心项目，等待ERCOT对项目储备进行全面审查。此举使电力接入成为AI基础设施的直接约束因素；即便芯片供应充足，服务器、加速器、存储和网络设备的需求兑现时间也可能受到影响。

title.en: Court Hears That Former Samsung Engineers Took 18nm DRAM Process Recipes to CXMT
title.zh: 法院审理前Samsung工程师向CXMT泄露18nm DRAM工艺配方一案

summary.en: A Korean court heard allegations that former Samsung engineers stole recipes for the company's 18nm-class DRAM process and intended them for CXMT; one former engineer is now imprisoned. The case puts process know-how, rather than only equipment access, at the center of China's memory expansion and could intensify scrutiny of hiring and technology transfer across the regional supply chain.
summary.zh: 韩国法院审理的指控称，前Samsung工程师窃取了该公司18nm级DRAM制程配方并拟提供给CXMT，其中一名前工程师现已入狱。此案表明，制程诀窍与设备获取同样是中国存储扩张的核心，并可能加剧区域供应链对人才流动和技术转移的审查。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: KT Unveils an On-Premise NPU Server for Sovereign AI
title.zh: KT发布面向主权AI的本地部署NPU服务器

summary.en: KT unveiled NPU LLM Station, a fully on-premise server aimed at sovereign-AI deployments. The product gives organizations an alternative to cloud-hosted GPU inference when data residency and operational control matter, although the candidate report provides no throughput, power, or customer-deployment figures for comparing the NPU platform with incumbent systems.
summary.zh: KT发布了NPU LLM Station，这是一款面向主权AI部署的全本地服务器。当数据驻留和运营控制至关重要时，该产品为机构提供了云端GPU推理之外的选择；不过候选报道没有给出吞吐量、功耗或客户部署数据，尚难与主流系统直接比较。

theme.en: Specialized Hardware Moves Compute Toward the Sensor
theme.zh: 专用硬件将计算推向传感端

dek.en: This thin research window centers on fixed-point biosignal analytics, memristive in-sensor computing, and probabilistic hardware for 3D reconstruction. The efficiency claims are still bounded by synthesis, review-level evidence, or simulation, leaving measured deployment as the central gap.
dek.zh: 本期较薄的研究窗口聚焦于定点生物信号分析、忆阻器传感内计算，以及用于3D重建的概率计算硬件。其效率结论仍受限于综合结果、综述性证据或仿真，实测部署仍是最关键的缺口。

title.en: Circuits, Architecture & Reliability
title.zh: 电路、架构与可靠性

title.en: Fixed-Point Hardware for Hjorth-Feature Cardiac Fibrillation Diagnosis
title.zh: 用于Hjorth特征心颤诊断的定点硬件

papers.authors: I. Kouretas, A. G. Skrivanos, N. Sagias, et al.

summary.en: A fully synthesizable fixed-point pipeline computes Hjorth activity, mobility, and complexity in real time, then feeds those features directly to a quantized neural network. At 10–12 bits, the design reports about 93.7% classification accuracy and an AUC above 0.97 on the SPHD dataset, close to its floating-point baseline. The result is application-specific and synthesis-focused rather than measured silicon, so area, energy, and generalization beyond the selected clinical dataset remain open questions.
summary.zh: 该工作实现了一条可完全综合的定点流水线，可实时计算Hjorth活动度、移动度和复杂度，并将特征直接送入量化神经网络。在10–12 bit配置下，设计在SPHD数据集上报告约93.7%的分类准确率和高于0.97的AUC，接近浮点基线。该结果面向特定应用，且主要基于综合而非实测芯片，因此面积、能耗以及对所选临床数据集之外的泛化能力仍待验证。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: From Memristive Biosensors to In-Sensor Computing
title.zh: 从忆阻式生物传感器到传感内计算

papers.authors: H. Ryu, W.-C. Lee, J. Lee

summary.en: This review traces memristive biosensors from direct and indirect transduction through on-chip integration and in-sensor computing, where sensing, storage, and processing share one physical platform. The architecture could reduce data movement in point-of-care systems, but the paper identifies CMOS compatibility, device variability, and reliable multi-threshold operation as unresolved barriers. It is a field map rather than a new measured device result, making it most useful for understanding integration tradeoffs and open engineering problems.
summary.zh: 这篇综述梳理了忆阻式生物传感器从直接、间接换能，到片上集成和传感内计算的发展路径；在后一种架构中，感知、存储与处理共处同一物理平台。该架构有望减少即时检测系统的数据搬运，但论文指出CMOS兼容性、器件波动以及可靠的多阈值工作仍是未解决障碍。这是一幅领域路线图，而非新的实测器件结果，主要价值在于理解集成权衡和待解工程问题。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: ProbSplat: Probabilistic Hardware for Gaussian Splatting
title.zh: ProbSplat：面向Gaussian Splatting的概率计算硬件

papers.authors: S. Gottumukkula, M. P. Samartha, V. Pahariya, et al.

summary.en: ProbSplat stores independently programmable Gaussian means and variances in floating-gate inverter columns and evaluates log-likelihoods for 3D scene reconstruction. A simulated 180nm, 1.8V design operating at 50MHz reports less than 2.4% mean-variance deviation and 18pJ per 4-bit log-likelihood inference across 500 mixture functions. The approach targets a data-movement-heavy edge workload, but all headline results are simulation-only and need array-level silicon measurements, endurance data, and comparisons against current digital accelerators.
summary.zh: ProbSplat在浮栅反相器列中分别编程并存储Gaussian分布的均值与方差，并为3D场景重建计算对数似然。其180nm、1.8V、50MHz仿真设计在500个混合函数上报告低于2.4%的均值—方差偏差，以及每次4 bit对数似然推理18pJ的能耗。该方案瞄准数据搬运密集的边缘工作负载，但核心结果全部来自仿真，仍需阵列级芯片实测、耐久性数据，并与当前数字加速器比较。
